context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe Subscription System fully tested and working. Logo sizes verified: Landing page navbar logo is 100px (h-24/h-[100px] class), Login/Register pages have 80px logos (h-20), Sidebar has 64px logo (h-16). Plan limits configured: Free (3 accounts, 500 contacts, 500 recipients), Starter (10, 4000, 4000), Growth (15, 10000, 10000). New users get 14-day trial with subscription_status='trialing'.
